# Opt-out list for scripts/ci/check-no-larger-runners.py (bin/ci --quick, check larger-runners).
#
# GitHub bills larger runners (macOS xlarge/large, Linux or Windows N-core,
# custom larger-runner groups) even on public repositories. Standard runners on
# trycua/cua are free. October 2026: $3.4k on this repo for larger runners.
#
# To allow one workflow to use one larger-runner label, add a line:
#     <workflow file name> <label>   # why, who approved, tracking issue
# Every entry needs a comment with the reason and Francesco's approval.
# This list starts empty on purpose.
